measurement_1_predeclared_semantic_affec.interpretation: The full-route sign reversal is not explained by an oppositely directed non-boundary update. Boundary-only and non-boundary-only effects are both donor-directed on average, but their joint native decode reverses. No lane flips the discrete answer prediction.

measurement_2_composition_interaction.interpretation: The native layer-16 input decompositions and the local linear predictions are exactly additive, while the observed BF16 answer margins are strongly non-additive. The newly located wall is downstream composition/readout interaction, not loss of either disjoint position component at injection.

measurement_3_local_answer_axis_oracle.interpretation: A label-aware projection onto the local answer gradient still produces no endpoint margin movement in all four affected cases at native gain. Local-gradient alignment alone does not bridge the coarse native answer readout.

measurement_4_specificity_and_stability.interpretation: The learned semantic boundary lane separates directionally from the random control at the predeclared endpoint, but the sample is predecessor-selected, unrelated controls also move, unaffected position lanes are not uniformly stable, and no prediction flips. Specificity and semantic promotion therefore remain unsupported.

supported: The complete learned reader update can be replayed and decomposed into two exact native BF16 position partitions.
At the predecessor-informed semantic h4 cell, answer-boundary and non-boundary updates are separately donor-directed on average while their full composition is donor-opposed.
The sign reversal is downstream of the additive layer-16 input and is invisible to a first-order local decomposition.
A native-gain label-aware answer-axis oracle remains below the observed endpoint margin lattice.
not_supported: A negative non-boundary component as the simple cause of full-route reversal.
Any intact-to-twin discrete answer flip in the position lanes.
A deployable answer-axis route, because the oracle uses labels and has zero endpoint effect.
Specificity, semantic memory, generalization, natural chat behavior, or promotion of either checkpoint.
overall_conclusion.smallest_next_gate: Hold the exact same boundary states and position lanes fixed, expose the final normalized hidden state, and compare native BF16 candidate logits with an FP32 two-choice head readout. If the negative composition interaction disappears before BF16 logit casting, the next bridge is precision-localized readout; if it remains, localize the nonlinear interaction through the upper decoder layers before training a position gate.
